page_title: SEV 1-1 MAL | Sevilla v Mallorca 24/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Alejandro Ruiz to decide. The relieved Mallorca players can finally celebrate.
90+3' Celebrations by Mallorca are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
90+1' 1 - 1 What a brilliant finish! Martin Valjent (Mallorca) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and fires the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
89' Jose Copete (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.

87' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
87' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
86' Here is a change. Juanlu Sanchez is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Maffeo departs the field of play to be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).

85' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
84' The linesman makes the right call and Mallorca will have a corner.
82' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Ruben Vargas will be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) coming on for Djibril Sow.
82' Referee Alejandro Ruiz has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
81' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Mallorca for a penalty. Play continues.
81' The ball is out of play. Mallorca will take a throw-in.
80' Mallorca work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

78' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Robert Navarro (Mallorca) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
77' The substitution is prepared. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergi Darder.
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdon Prats (Mallorca) replacing Daniel Rodriguez.
77' Substitution. Vedat Muriqi did his best and is replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
76' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dodi Lukebakio, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

75' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
75' The game is interrupted. Martin Valjent (Mallorca) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
73' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' The ball is out of play. Mallorca will have a throw-in.
70' Half-chance! Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) plays a pass into the box, but Dominik Greif reacts well to snuff out the attack.
69' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a long ball forward to Johan Mojica, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sevilla.
68' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takuma Asano leaves the pitch and Robert Navarro (Mallorca) comes on.

67' Great solo effort from Isaac Romero (Sevilla)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
66' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
65' 14:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
64' Sevilla are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
63' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
62' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Kike Salas (Sevilla), whose header goes wide of the goal.
60' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Johan Mojica (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.

58' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
58' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game. One of the players from Sevilla won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
57' It's a throw-in after the ball crosses the sideline.

56' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
55' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
54' The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.
54' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Loic Bade (Sevilla) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
50' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Mallorca.

49' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Saul Niguez (Sevilla), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
48' Dominik Greif pulls off a great save to deny Ruben Vargas (Sevilla), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
47' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the right-hand post!
46' The linesman signals a throw-in for Sevilla.
46' Referee Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 0 Goal! Kike Salas (Sevilla) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
45+2' It seemed like Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.

42' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Dominik Greif sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
41' An attempted cross from Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is cleared.
39' It will be an indirect long-range free kick for Sevilla.
39' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
38' A brilliant cross into the box finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
36' The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.
35' Sevilla keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
33' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
32' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) attempts to find Vedat Muriqi, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
30' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
30' Sevilla take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sevilla will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
28' A pass by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a throw-in.
26' The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
25' A cross into the box from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is cleared.
24' A cross into the box picks out Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
22' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

20' Kike Salas (Sevilla) finds some space inside the box to connect with the resulting corner kick. He wallops the ball close to the left post, but it's finally blocked by one of the defenders. Maybe next time.
19' Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Vedat Muriqi wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
18' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
17' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
17' The ball is out of play. Mallorca will take a throw-in.
15' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
14' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
14' A cross from Saul Niguez (Sevilla) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
10' The ball goes out of play and it is going to be a throw-in.
9' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

9' The ball rebounds out to Johan Mojica (Mallorca) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
8' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It's a throw-in for Mallorca.
7' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
6' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
2' A player from Sevilla commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The ball has crossed the sideline. Mallorca are taking a throw-in.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
